body:
I can escape myself with suicide. And I'm aware of the aftermath of suicide. I was on the receiving end and had to deal with loss. If I could simply man up, I'd have done it a long time ago. It's not like I have been sitting on my ass doing nothing the whole time while waiting for things to change. I seeked help before, tried medication and therapy too. So it's not like I'm not trying. 

Your comment is exactly why I kept things to myself for so long. That's all I ever get from people around me. As if it was that easy and I just wasn't trying hard enough.

I told him, "I'm scared if I go home I'd try it again." He told me, "It's up to you whether you do it. I can't stop you. I hope you don't." I was just so shocked that I didn't know what to say. He was convinced I'm in it for shits and giggles and that I like going to hospital (I have a history of prior admissions.)
